prompt: # CODING-AI PROMPT — COMPLETE LANDING PAGE BUILD · THEME: "SPACE WESTERN" **Role:** You are a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build the complete, production-ready Landing Page described below on the first attempt, in a single pass. Every rule in this specification is mandatory — where your habits conflict with a rule, the rule wins. --- ## 0. PROJECT BRIEF & ART DIRECTION **0.1 Theme & Mood** — "Space Western" (claude-artisan/retrofuturism, 1950s–present): science-fiction storytelling that borrows frontier motifs — dusty horizons, saloons, wanted posters, stamped labels, and practical, lived-in spacecraft. Reference moods: Cowboy Bebop, Firefly, the machinery of frontier science fiction. **0.2 Visual Language & Effects** — Dusty desert neutrals against nocturnal space; stenciled utility type; star-map details; weathered panels with 1px dust-tone borders; stamped monospace labels; frontier red accents; layered shadow and blur (dust-gradient haze, blurred sticky nav floating over the star field). All decorative art — star fields, orbit dashes, dust haze, rivets, stamp frames — must be built with pure CSS (gradients, box-shadows, pseudo-elements). No images, no SVG. **0.3 Dual-Mode Mandate** — The source style declares no light/dark modes; you must design, build, and validate **both** themes before delivery. Dark ("Nocturnal Space") is the brand default; Light ("Dusty Desert") is its sun-bleached counterpart. Both must pass the contrast checks in Section 3. **0.4 Design Token Contract** — Map the source palette onto these mandatory token names: *Dark theme (default, defined on `:root`):* - `--bg-primary: #17151a` (nocturnal void) · `--bg-secondary: #272129` (weathered panel) · extra `--surface-raised: #44363a` - `--text-primary: #f5e5c8` · `--text-secondary: #c6ae91` - `--primary: #d56b3e` (frontier red) · `--secondary: #74bcc1` (star-chart teal) · extra `--dust: #b58b61` - `--border-default`: derive from `--dust` (solid or alpha-reduced) - `--text-success` / `--border-success`: desaturated green family that reads on dark (e.g., `#8fb573`) - `--text-error` / `--border-error`: a true red clearly distinct from `--primary` (e.g., `#e5484d`) *Light theme (overrides under the light theme class — starting values; tune until WCAG AA passes):* - `--bg-primary: #efe6d4` (sun-bleached sand — never pure white; use `#fefefe` only where a near-white is genuinely required) · `--bg-secondary: #e4d7bd` · `--surface-raised: #d9c9a9` - `--text-primary: #2a2119` · `--text-secondary: #6b5a44` - `--primary: #c05323` (darkened for AA on sand; keep `#d56b3e` for large display fills) · `--secondary: #1e6b72` · `--dust: #8a6544` - Success/error tokens re-tuned for light backgrounds *Shared tokens:* - Radius: `--radius-sm: 2px` · `--radius-md: 6px` · `--radius-lg: 12px` · `--radius-pill: 999px` - Shadows: `--shadow-sm` (subtle lift) · `--shadow-md` = `0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.18) inset, 0 8px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.3)` (re-tint the inset highlight for light mode) · signature `--shadow-stamp: 3px 3px 0` hard offset in the current `--text-primary` tone - Spacing: source scale `--space-1 … --space-24` plus `--spacing-gap: var(--space-4)` - Motion: `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.3,1)` · `--transition-fast: .15s var(--ease-standard)` · `--transition-normal: .3s var(--ease-standard)` - Type scale: `--text-xs: .75rem` through `--text-5xl: 4rem` (use `clamp()` for `--text-2xl` and above) - Stacking: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast` — strictly ordered values - Signature: `--dust-gradient: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(181,139,97,.28), transparent 52%)` (re-tune alpha for light mode) **0.5 Typography & Icon Direction** — Stenciled display type for headlines and wordmark (uppercase, generous letter-spacing); utility sans for body; monospace for stamped labels, coordinates, prices, and attributions. Icons: Google Material Symbols, frontier/space vocabulary (e.g., `rocket_launch`, `explore`, `route`, `shield`, `handshake`, `receipt_long`, `pin_drop`, `star`, `check`, `close`, `expand_more`, `light_mode`, `dark_mode`, `arrow_forward`, `mail`). Decorative icons get `aria-hidden="true"`; icon-only controls get `aria-label`. **0.6 Page Section Map (build in this order; write real English copy for every section — Space Western flavor lives in labels, stamps, and names while body copy stays plain and scannable; no lorem ipsum):** 1. **Header / Sticky Nav** — stencil brand wordmark (invent one fitting name, e.g., "RED DUST FREIGHT CO.", used consistently site-wide); anchor links: Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ; theme toggle; compact `.btn` "Book Passage". Sticky with `backdrop-filter: blur()` over the star field; wraps/stacks at ≤620px. 2. **Hero** — dashed-border stamp badge in mono (e.g., "TRANSMISSION // OUTER-RIM SUPPLY LINES"); single stencil `h1` stating the core promise (direction: "Frontier freight, delivered before dawn."); 1–2 sentence muted subcopy; CTA pair: `.btn--primary` "Book a Cargo Run" (scrolls to Pricing) + `.btn` "View the Star Charts" (scrolls to Features); decorative mono coordinates line; star-map backdrop via a fixed, `pointer-events: none` CSS star field plus `--dust-gradient` haze. 3. **Features — 3 cards** — auto-fit row of `.card`s: Material icon in a stamped chip, stencil `h3`, 2–3 sentence muted copy, mono stamp tag. Angles: armored cargo (`shield`), live star-chart routing (`explore`), frontier-grade support (`handshake`). 4. **How It Works — 3 steps** — mono step stamps "01 / 02 / 03"; dashed CSS connector between steps (horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile); each step: icon, stencil title, copy. Flow: file the manifest → route is plotted → cargo delivered. 5. **Testimonials — 3 quote cards** — quote in body font; star rating via Material `star` icons (mix 4s and 5s); mono attribution ("— NAME · VESSEL/COMPANY"); CSS-only monogram avatar chip. 6. **Pricing — 3 tiers** — theme-voiced names (e.g., Drifter / Marshal / Syndicate); middle tier highlighted with a `--primary` border, stamped "RECOMMENDED" badge, `--shadow-md` elevation, and `.btn--primary`; outer tiers use `.btn`. Mono/display price with flavor unit ("per cycle"); 4–6 `check`-icon features per tier. All CTAs scroll to the Final CTA. 7. **FAQ — 4–6 items** — real questions in theme voice; accordion behavior per §2.5. 8. **Final CTA** — full-bleed weathered band (dust border, panel shadow, dust gradient): stencil headline, short copy, email-capture `.input-group` + `.btn--primary` "Join the Manifest" with full form-state behavior and `aria-live` feedback. 9. **Footer** — brand + one-line tagline; 2–3 groups of secondary links (e.g., Company, Routes, Legal — real English labels; `href="#"` permitted only for these unspecified destinations); bottom bar with mono stamp ("© 2071 RED DUST FREIGHT CO. — ALL ROUTES RESERVED") and a "Back to top" link.
